name: Suzushiro Nanami
source:
Class: 2nd year student in the special advance class
Zodiac Sign: Virgo
Musical Instrument: Her voice
Hobbies: Singing, watching movies

Heartthrob of the school that has the voice of an angel.
Nanami has a fluffy atmosphere around her, she is very friendly and gentle. No matter what is said to her, she will approach anybody without anger. She has a habit to treat anyone like her friend and to avoid creating walls between people. Nanami has a very large impact on whoever she sees as her friend or acquaintance; they remember her for a long time, even after their friendship comes to an end.
Although she is a member of many student clubs in her school, Nanami is an inactive member in each one them.
Due to her beautiful appearance and cheerful disposition she is treated as the school's idol. Every time she sings with her beautiful voice a great commotion of students is gathered around her.
